integrity: Proof is analytic; the accompanying exhaustive finite-state and finite-mode calculations are independent diagnostic checks rather than infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Only stationary walk-endpoint correlation, not crossing-event correlation or global mixing.
Assumes the free terminal increment flip, uniform initial fair increments and stated discrete update clock.
Historical uniqueness against all possible classical exclusion formulations is not established.
title: Exact endpoint decorrelation for the peak/valley dynamics of open meandric walks
